title: A Look Back on Valentine’s Day

sentences.en: I'm Jenna Fisher.
And I'm Angela Kinsey.
We were on The Office together.
sentences.zh: 我们曾一起出演《办公室》。

sentences.en: And we're best friends.
And now we're doing the Ultimate Office rewatch podcast just for you.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们专门为你制作了这档《办公室》终极重温播客。

sentences.en: Each week, we will break down an episode of The Office and give exclusive behind-the-scenes stories that only two people who were there can tell you.
sentences.zh: 每周，我们都会深度解析一集《办公室》，并分享只有身临其境的我们才能告诉你的独家幕后故事。

sentences.en: We're The Office ladies.
Today, we are talking about the Valentine's Day episode.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们要聊的是情人节那一集。

sentences.en: I am so excited for this one.
Me too.
I liked this one so much, I watched it an extra time in my prep.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢这一集了，备课时我又多看了一遍。

sentences.en: I did too.
Just for pleasure.
I did too.
My husband Josh was like, babe, how many times are you going to watch that episode?
sentences.zh: 我丈夫乔什问我：宝贝，你到底要看多少遍那一集？

sentences.en: I was like, I am really enjoying it.
sentences.zh: 我说：我真的很享受看它。

sentences.en: I think this one sneaked up on me because there are certain episodes that I remember as being favorites.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这一集让我感到意外，因为有些集数我一直记得是我的最爱。

sentences.en: Yeah.
And this one was not on my radar.
sentences.zh: 而这一集之前并不在我的关注名单里。

sentences.en: And then I watched it and so many memories came back too.
sentences.zh: 但看完之后，好多回忆都涌上心头。

sentences.en: So many.
Okay, this is a goodie.
This is Season 2, Episode 16, written by Mike Schur and directed by Greg Daniels.
sentences.zh: 这是第二季第16集，由迈克·舒尔编剧，格雷格·丹尼尔斯执导。

sentences.en: I mean, honestly, that's all you need to know right there.
sentences.zh: 说实话，光看这些信息就足够了。

sentences.en: That's like the super team.
Yeah, of course this is a great one.
sentences.zh: 没错，这集当然会很精彩。

sentences.en: All right, I'll give a summary.
It's Valentine's Day at Dunder Mifflin.
sentences.zh: 邓德·米夫林公司迎来了情人节。

sentences.en: Michael has to go to the corporate offices in New York.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔必须去纽约的公司总部。

sentences.en: He has to meet and do a presentation for the new CFO, Chief Financial Officer.
sentences.zh: 他要与新任首席财务官（CFO）会面并进行演示。

sentences.en: It's a big deal.
It is.
And he's going to be there with Jan on Valentine's Day.
sentences.zh: 而且他要在情人节那天和简待在一起。

sentences.en: Oh, no.
Back at the office, Phyllis is overwhelmed by gifts from her boyfriend, Bob Vance, at Vance Refrigeration.
sentences.zh: 在办公室这边，菲利斯被她男友——万斯制冷公司的鲍勃·万斯送的礼物淹没了。

sentences.en: They just come all day, these gifts.
sentences.zh: 这些礼物一整天都在送来。

sentences.zh: 来自巴尔的摩的阿什莉的粉丝提问。

sentences.en: What was the thought process behind Pam's hair for this episode?
sentences.zh: 这一集中帕姆的发型设计思路是什么？

sentences.en: Was there another special meeting?
I bet there was.
Oh, my gosh.
You guys.
I also got similar questions from Casey McMillan and many other people asking if there was a special
sentences.zh: 凯西·麦克米伦和许多其他人也问过我类似的问题，问是不是专门为帕姆的发型开过一个

sentences.en: meeting for Pam's hair.
There was more than a meeting.
It was like the Joint Chiefs of Staff came together for your hair.
sentences.zh: 简直就像参谋长联席会议为了你的发型聚在了一起。

sentences.en: So the thought process here was that Pam and Jim in this episode, they're going to be a bit estranged.
sentences.zh: 所以当时的构思是，帕姆和吉姆在这一集中会有些疏远。

sentences.en: So wouldn't it be an extra nail in the coffin for Jim if Pam just looked super duper cute?
sentences.zh: 那么如果帕姆看起来超级可爱，对吉姆来说岂不是雪上加霜？

sentences.en: Right.
So we thought, can we please do something different with her hair?
sentences.zh: 所以我们想，能不能在她的发型上做点不一样的尝试？

sentences.en: I had a MySpace blog at the time and I wrote about my hair and I said that Kim Ferry and I worked for weeks on different versions of this look.
sentences.zh: 我当时有个MySpace博客，我在上面写到了我的发型，我说金·费里和我为了这个造型的不同版本研究了好几周。

sentences.en: Well, knowing Kim Ferry like I do, like you do, she must have been so excited because she was so good at hair, but she never got to do much with our hair.
sentences.zh: 嗯，像我一样了解金·费里的人都知道，她当时一定很兴奋，因为她非常擅长做发型，但平时却没机会在我们的头发上大展身手。

sentences.en: No.
Okay.
So here's what we tried.
sentences.zh: 所以我们尝试了这些方案。

sentences.en: We tried a ponytail, a barrette, and headbands.
sentences.zh: 我们试了马尾辫、发夹和发带。

sentences.en: We took a picture of each choice and we presented them to Greg Daniels and he went through the photos and had to pick hairstyle and he picked the headband and there were various headbands.
sentences.zh: 我们给每个造型都拍了照，然后拿给格雷格·丹尼尔斯看，他翻看照片并从中挑选，最后选定了发带，而且当时有很多种发带。

sentences.en: I was going to say, were there 12 different headbands?
sentences.zh: 我正想问，是不是有12种不同的发带？

sentences.en: Yes.
Yes.
So it was, and also ponytails, high pony, low pony, side pony.
sentences.zh: 确实是，还有马尾辫，高马尾、低马尾、侧马尾。

sentences.en: No side pony.
Well, side pony shows up later at the art fair.
sentences.zh: 好吧，侧马尾后来在艺术展上出现了。

sentences.en: Um, I wore a side ponytail to my prom.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我参加毕业舞会时扎的就是侧马尾。

sentences.en: My, I think it was my, my senior year I did a side pony.
sentences.zh: 我记得是在我高三那年扎的侧马尾。

sentences.en: I was not cool, guys.
sentences.zh: 伙计们，我当时一点也不酷。

sentences.zh: 你扎着侧马尾去参加毕业舞会？

I did a side.
Did you get that done at a salon or did you do that at home?
sentences.zh: 那是去沙龙做的，还是你自己在家弄的？

sentences.en: No, my mom did it.
My mom did it and that was the year, the year before we had all had dates and none of us had a good time.
sentences.zh: 是我妈弄的，那年之前我们都有舞伴，但大家玩得都不开心。

sentences.zh: 就是我那群非常要好的闺蜜。

sentences.en: Yeah.

sentences.zh: 所以那一年，男生们觉得自己很酷，他们说，我们今年不带舞伴去了。

And so the girls were like, fine.

sentences.zh: 我们的毕业舞会，我扎着侧马尾，和所有的闺蜜围成一圈跳舞。

sentences.zh: 天哪，我的毕业舞会也是全女生参加的。

sentences.zh: 那我们肯定会在同一个跳舞圈子里。

sentences.zh: 你一定会喜欢我的侧马尾的。

sentences.zh: 我有一张关于那个冷知识的卡片。

sentences.zh: 我是说，不仅是帕姆的发型，帕姆还穿着一件粉色毛衣。

She has a heart necklace on.
She has pink earrings on.
I mean.
Little pink dangle earrings.
I know.

sentences.zh: 那位女士来了，感觉她是特意来引人注目的。

sentences.zh: 我觉得她还涂了点唇彩。

sentences.en: Yes.
It was a whole look.
I have to say when I first saw myself on screen, I was a little bit like, oh.
sentences.zh: 我得说，当我第一次在屏幕上看到自己时，我有点……噢。

sentences.en: Oh, Pam went for it.
Pam showed up today.
And I mean, I mean, it's going to play out later in the episode, but like, Roy, come on.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我是说，这在剧集后面会体现出来，但是罗伊，拜托。

sentences.en: This is someone who clearly wants a valentine.
sentences.zh: 这明显是一个想要情人节礼物的人。

sentences.en: So clearly.
No matter what she says.
Okay.

Fast fact number two.
Fast fact number two.
A portion of this episode was shot in New York City.
sentences.zh: 这一集的部分内容是在纽约市拍摄的。

sentences.zh: 我们收到了很多粉丝关于此事的提问。

sentences.zh: 人们想知道我们……史蒂夫是站在绿幕前吗？

sentences.en: Did we shoot on the streets of Los Angeles?
sentences.zh: 我们是在洛杉矶街头拍摄的吗？

sentences.en: No.
But there's more questions, Angela.
sentences.zh: 但还有更多问题，安吉拉。

sentences.en: Okay.
Fan question from Cora Louise.
sentences.zh: 来自科拉·路易斯的粉丝提问。

sentences.zh: 有多少剧组成员去了纽约市？

sentences.en: And Guava Aura asked, how long did it take to shoot this episode in New York?
sentences.zh: 还有瓜娃·奥拉问，在纽约拍摄这一集花了多长时间？

sentences.en: And was the rest of the cast in California?
sentences.zh: 其他演员当时都在加州吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
We did not get to go.
We did not.
We were all pretty bummed because it sounded like so much fun.
sentences.zh: 我们都很沮丧，因为听起来太好玩了。

sentences.en: So I reached out to Randall Einhorn, our director of photography.
sentences.zh: 所以我联系了我们的摄影指导兰德尔·艾因霍恩。

sentences.en: Jenna, you know I did this.
sentences.zh: 珍娜，你知道我这么做了。

sentences.en: I know.
And you guys, she wouldn't tell me what he said.
sentences.zh: 你们知道吗，她不肯告诉我他说了什么。

sentences.en: She's got all this good information about the New York shoot and she made me wait.
sentences.zh: 她掌握了所有关于纽约拍摄的内幕消息，却让我等着。

sentences.en: Well, this is something we do.
We both love to like dig up nuggets of info and then we don't tell each other because
sentences.zh: 我们都喜欢挖掘信息碎片，然后不告诉对方，因为

sentences.en: we want the surprise.
I know.
So I've been waiting like five days for this.
sentences.zh: 所以我为了这个已经等了五天了。

sentences.en: Okay.
Here we go.
So I reached out to Randall and he said the crew in New York was just him and Greg and
sentences.zh: 所以我联系了兰德尔，他说在纽约的剧组只有他和格雷格，还有

sentences.en: Steve that would go out on the street when they would film.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫，他们拍摄时会走到街上。

sentences.en: Yeah.
And in the van they had like I think two crew members that were New York based like because
sentences.zh: 而且在面包车里，我想他们有两名纽约当地的剧组成员，因为

sentences.en: they had to do things by the rules, you know.
sentences.zh: 他们必须按规矩办事，你懂的。

sentences.en: And our line producer Kent Zabornak, but whenever the van doors would open, it would just be
sentences.zh: 还有我们的制片主任肯特·扎博纳克，但每当面包车门打开时，出来的就只有

sentences.en: Greg, Steve, and Randall.
sentences.zh: 格雷格、史蒂夫和兰德尔。

sentences.en: He said that this was right at the height of 40-year-old Virgin.
sentences.zh: 他说那正好是《四十岁的老处男》最火的时候。

sentences.en: It was the biggest movie in America.
sentences.zh: 那是全美最热门的电影。

sentences.en: He said there was a billboard in Times Square where they were filming.
sentences.zh: 他说在他们拍摄的地方，时代广场上挂着一块广告牌。

sentences.en: So he said the minute Steve would get out of the van, a crowd would form.
sentences.zh: 所以他说史蒂夫一从车里出来，人群就会围上来。

sentences.en: So he said they had to move really fast and quickly and he said he used a Handicam camera,
sentences.zh: 所以他说他们必须动作非常快，而且他说他用的是一台手持摄像机，

sentences.en: like a basic Handicam camera that you could buy at Costco.
sentences.zh: 就像你在好市多能买到的那种普通手持摄像机。

sentences.en: Whoa.
It's a really small camera, so not to draw a lot of attention to them.
sentences.zh: 那是一台非常小的摄像机，为了不引起太多人的注意。

sentences.en: Yeah.
Because the minute people saw Steve, literally he said a crowd would form.
sentences.zh: 因为人们一看到史蒂夫，他说真的，人群立刻就会围上来。

sentences.en: Well, wasn't this also right after his Golden Globe win?
sentences.zh: 嗯，这不也正好是在他获得金球奖之后吗？

sentences.en: Oh, yes.
Yes.
It was all of that.
He just won the Golden Globe.
There was a billboard of him in Times Square, and they're going to film on the streets of New York.
sentences.zh: 时代广场上挂着他的广告牌，而他们却要在纽约街头拍摄。

sentences.en: Bonkers.
Bonkers.
Now, this was scripted, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，这部分是有剧本的。

sentences.en: They had certain scripted spots, but I know that Steve was also improvising and riffing at the same time.
sentences.zh: 他们确实有一些预设的剧本情节，但我知道史蒂夫当时也在即兴发挥。

sentences.en: It was very loosey-goosey.
That's true.
That's true.
So I asked Randall, okay, what were some of the things that you know were scripted?
sentences.zh: 所以我问兰德尔，好吧，有哪些部分是你确定是有剧本的？

sentences.en: He said the Rockefeller Center portion was scripted.
sentences.zh: 他说洛克菲勒中心那部分是有剧本的。

sentences.en: He said that Sbarro was scripted, but he said that he's pretty sure when Steve goes into the subway
sentences.zh: 他说萨巴罗披萨店那段也是剧本里的，但他很确定当史蒂夫走进地铁

sentences.en: and sees a man pooping in the box, that was improv.
sentences.zh: 看到一个人在盒子里拉屎时，那是即兴表演。

sentences.en: That was Steve just goofing around.
But Steve did a lot of improv.
sentences.zh: 但史蒂夫确实做了很多即兴表演。

sentences.en: Like, whenever they saw something or they had a moment, he would hop out.
sentences.zh: 比如，每当他们看到什么东西或者有了灵感，他就会跳出去。

sentences.en: You know, there's a tag at the end of, like, the fiddler on the roof, like him goofing around.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在《屋顶上的提琴手》结尾有个彩蛋，就是他胡闹的片段。

sentences.en: That's improv.
There's a bunch of deleted scenes of him on the streets of New York that I think are a lot of improvisations.
sentences.zh: 还有一堆他在纽约街头的删减片段，我认为很多都是即兴发挥的。

sentences.en: They're fantastic.
The deleted scenes for this are great, and I'll bring up some more of them later.
sentences.zh: 这部剧的删减片段很棒，我稍后会再提到一些。

sentences.en: And then I said, Randall, is there, like, a fun story or a memory you have from filming in New York
sentences.zh: 然后我问兰德尔，有没有什么你在纽约拍摄时发生的趣事或回忆，

sentences.en: that maybe doesn't even have anything to do with the episode?
sentences.zh: 可能甚至和这集内容都没什么关系的？

sentences.en: And he said, yes.
This is what he said.

sentences.zh: 他说他们到纽约的那天晚上，他和史蒂夫去了个叫强尼的地方，

sentences.en: and they got beer and pizza.
sentences.zh: 他们喝了啤酒，吃了披萨。

sentences.zh: 他说他以为那披萨是意大利辣香肠味的。

sentences.en: But he just said it was really special, and they were walking back to their hotel,
sentences.zh: 但他只是说那真的很特别，他们走回酒店，

sentences.zh: 穿过时代广场，他说到处都是广告牌，

sentences.en: a 40-year-old virgin with Steve's face, like, all over the place.
sentences.zh: 到处都是印着史蒂夫脸的《四十岁的老处男》广告。

sentences.en: And the show was getting popular.
sentences.zh: 而且这部剧也正变得越来越受欢迎。

sentences.en: Steve had just won a Golden Globe, so it was kind of surreal to walk through all of those,
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫刚赢了金球奖，所以走在那些史蒂夫的广告牌中间，

sentences.en: you know, billboards of Steve.

sentences.zh: 人们开始走向史蒂夫，兰德尔说史蒂夫对待每一个人都一样亲切友善，

sentences.en: to the first person who stopped him as he was to the 100th.
sentences.zh: 无论是第一个拦住他的人，还是第一百个。

sentences.en: He just was so kind and in the moment.
sentences.zh: 他就是那么友善，而且非常专注当下。

sentences.en: But that is Steve, you know?
sentences.zh: 但这就是史蒂夫，你知道吧？

sentences.en: He is so kind and gracious.
sentences.zh: 他就是那么友善和亲切。

sentences.en: night together like that, just grabbing a slice and a beer and being in New York.
sentences.zh: 一起去吃块披萨、喝杯啤酒，就在纽约待着。
